title: Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence - Natural Language Processing
institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)
about: MBZUAI's Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence with a Natural Language Processing focus accepts applications until 15 December 2026 (5 p.m. GST) for the cycle with decisions by 31 March 2027. Applicants need a STEM bachelor's with CGPA 3.0 or above.
requirements: Completed bachelor's degree in a STEM field with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent
Portal opened September 7, 2026; final deadline December 15, 2026 (5 p.m. GST); decisions by March 31, 2027

upskill.name: Natural Language Processing (NLP) I
why: Field "Natural language processing" → objective "Pre-trained language models: ELMo, BERT (2018), RoBERTa, XLNet"
Programme title "Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence - Natural Language Processing" → objective "Large Language Models (LLMs): GPT-3/4, PaLM, Claude, LLaMA - few-shot learners"

Requirement "Completed bachelor's degree in a STEM field" → objective "Statistical NLP (pre-2012): n-gram models, HMMs, CRFs for parsing and tagging" (foundation-level preparation for graduate NLP study)
